# rules/

Generated by `zdp export --format all --out rules` from `config/default.yaml`.
**Do not edit** — change the analyzer or the config and re-export; CI fails if
these files differ from a fresh export.

- `sigma/` — Sigma 2.x rules and correlation rules (validated with
  `sigma check --fail-on-issues`).
- `suricata/` — Suricata 8 rules (validated with `suricata -T`).
- `MANIFEST.json` — every rule with its detector, signal, fidelity tier, ID
  and file, plus the signals that could not be exported and why.

Each rule declares its fidelity tier (`full`, `approx`, `companion`) in a
header comment and in its title or metadata. See
[docs/export_fidelity.md](../docs/export_fidelity.md) for what each tier
means and why each rule has the tier it has.

Rule IDs are deterministic: a UUIDv5 of detector, signal and config hash
(Suricata SIDs are derived from it in the local range 1,000,000–1,999,999), so
re-exporting an unchanged config updates rules in place downstream.
